title: [Extensibility Request] issue 29901: expose item application entry before find
summary: An event is added before retrieving a filtered item application entry in the drop shipment undo process, allowing extensions with custom fields to adjust loaded fields and avoid JIT load-field errors.
key_points: New event fires before the item application entry is retrieved in UnApplyDropShipment
Enables extensions to adjust loaded fields on the item application entry record
Preserves standard optimization by keeping the filtered retrieval intact
Event propagated to both W1 and RU layer implementations
Resolves JIT load-field errors when extensions add fields to Item Application Entry
quote: added an event before finding the item application entry so subscribers can adjust loaded fields
